verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is designed as an SDK invoked programmatically from Workers code (getSandbox, exec, writeFile, sessions, SSE streams) with no GUI dependency, explicitly positioned for CI/CD systems and AI agents that execute code headlessly. Community feedback validates real-world usage but raises concerns about cold-start latency and lack of auto-idle cleanup, which are operational caveats rather than blockers to headless/CI use.
